mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin (store_id, booking_id, user_id, schedule_id, check_time, method, operator_id) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{bookingId}, #{userId}, #{scheduleId}, COALESCE(#{checkTime},NOW()), #{method}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} LIMIT 1
